# Zejios Cafe Management System
Android tablet-first POS admin interface built with Kotlin + XML in Android Studio.
## Implemented POS Screen
- Brown cafe-styled collapsible sidebar with active POS state - Tablet-first split layout (landscape 70/30) and portrait stacked layout - Search/filter row, icon category pills, responsive product grid, and order panel - Payment method selection, clear/checkout actions, and floating cart FAB - MVVM flow with `PosViewModel`, `RecyclerView` adapters, and sample product data - Product cards load realistic food/drink images via Coil
## Tech Stack
- Kotlin - Android Views + XML (`ConstraintLayout`, `RecyclerView`, Material Components) - MVVM (`ViewModel`, `LiveData`) - Coil image loading
## Run
```powershell ./gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug ```
Install the generated APK from `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/` on an emulator or device.
